create_evaluator_mt: create an EvaluatorMT instance to evaluate neural machine translation models with BLEU and perplexity scores
run_all_evals: run all parallel and pivot translation evaluations across valid and test sets for a given epoch
eval_para: evaluate perplexity and BLEU scores for a direct language pair translation direction
eval_back: evaluate perplexity and BLEU scores for a pivot translation path through an intermediate language
eval_moses_bleu: evaluate BLEU score between reference and hypothesis files using Moses multi-bleu.perl script
